spanish: Se desprecia la plata; a ellos se les llama plata despreciable, porque el Señor los desprecia.

findings.issue: YHWH rendered as 'el Señor' instead of conventional Jehová
adds 'plata despreciable' as the explicit name they are called, which the tokens do not license

notes: passive silver rejected and 3ms rejection by YHWH are preserved, but added interpretive naming and wrong divine name
